dominant_variable: Whether Plaque monetization per CCTA can expand rapidly enough, with durable ASP and gross-margin leverage, to outrun elevated price-implied expectations after the Q2 2026 rerating.

metric_ontology.revenue: GAAP revenue recognized on delivery of requested analyses.
metric_ontology.revenue_case: Each delivered FFRCT or Plaque analysis; one CCTA can create two revenue cases if both products are ordered.
metric_ontology.ccta_or_procedure_volume: Not equivalent to revenue cases; unique-procedure volume is not directly disclosed in the Q2 2026 10-Q.
metric_ontology.arr: Not a core reported KPI; substantially all revenue is usage-driven pay-per-click.
metric_ontology.backlog_rpo: Not a core economic KPI for this case; contract liabilities are small and the business is usage-driven rather than backlog-driven.
metric_ontology.gross_margin_leverage: Confirmed in Q2 2026: revenue +48% YoY while cost of revenue rose only about 2%, taking GAAP gross margin to ~83%.
metric_ontology.operating_leverage: Not yet confirmed on a GAAP basis in Q2 2026: total GAAP OpEx rose about 53% YoY, faster than revenue, and operating loss widened YoY.

lifecycle.note: IPO completed at $19; public-market price discovery began.
Q3 public history confirmed ~40% growth and clarified that revenue cases are analyses, not unique patients/procedures.
2025 10-K established a scaled FFRCT franchise; FFRCT represented 98% of revenue.
Q1 beat/raise and 80%+ gross margin strengthened the thesis, but the stock fell after the event; strong earnings did not equal a positive expectation gap.
Q2 accelerated revenue, Plaque adoption and gross margin; guidance rose materially.
Stock gapped +35.7% to $42.08; current diluted EV and ~15.3x FY2026 EV/Sales required re-underwriting and invalidated a strict first-New-Ignition label.
Case remains Confirmation/Early Momentum with second-S-curve optionality; direct IBKR close at $45.23 confirmed follow-through but did not change the economic lifecycle.

opportunity_setup.evidence: Q2 fundamental revision was followed by a +35.7% event-day gap, a largely held gap on 8/17, and a new high / $45.23 close on 8/18 using direct IBKR history.
opportunity_setup.guardrail: Lifecycle classification and opportunity setup are separate axes. Price follow-through does not prove institutional accumulation, gamma, CTA, short covering, or a positive-expectancy entry rule.
opportunity_setup.promotion_evidence_needed: PIT event study across comparable revenue-beat + guidance-raise gaps controlling for IPO age, market cap, growth, valuation, gap size, relative volume and market regime.

decision_state.action: watch_or_start_small; add only on improved price asymmetry, material upward revision to the 2028-2030 revenue/cash-flow path, or separately validated opportunity-capture evidence
kill_criteria: FFRCT utilization materially deteriorates without a temporary explanation.
Plaque activated-account growth does not translate into sustained attach/utilization growth.
Plaque or FFRCT net ASP deteriorates beyond the expected site-mix and rebate bridge.
Gross-margin leverage stalls despite Plaque mix and automation claims.
DOJ/CID produces a material adverse legal, reimbursement, or sales-practice outcome.
Competition materially weakens account wins, retention, or pricing power.
Dilution/SBC grows faster than per-share operating value creation.
Asymptomatic-market evidence or reimbursement fails while valuation capitalizes the optionality.

historical_checkpoints.note: Post-offering share count is reconstructed/provisional. A synchronized IPO-date cash/debt/forward-revenue convention is not forced.
Post-Q1 event close; economic dilution uses treasury-stock treatment and is provisional.
Economic diluted-share and EV figures are analytical reconstructions; leases are separately labeled.
Price/OHLCV from direct IBKR completed-session history; economic dilution reconstructed with treasury-stock treatment. True NTM/FY2027/FY2028 consensus multiples remain unavailable.

event_attribution.note: The 25.9% factor is 1.357/1.078-1 under a constant-near-term-sales-multiple bridge. It is an analytical decomposition, not a causal microstructure estimate. No buyer-type or derivatives-flow attribution is promoted without direct evidence.

false_stage_diagnosis.scanner_signal_that_was_correct: P0 research escalation after structural growth, revenue acceleration, guide raise, Plaque adoption, gross-margin expansion and price/volume confirmation.
false_stage_diagnosis.scanner_error: Converted high research priority and event confirmation into a New Ignition lifecycle label without completing the current diluted-EV, reverse-return, prior-lifecycle and metric-ontology gates.
guardrails: P0 research priority is independent of lifecycle state.
New Ignition remains provisional until current diluted EV and reverse 3x/5x/10x math are available.
A second-product S-curve is not automatically a company's first ignition.
Revenue cases must not be substituted for unique procedure/patient volume.
A material gap triggers re-underwriting at the new price rather than preserving the pre-event label.
Rejecting a New Ignition label must not automatically reject a separately underwritten opportunity setup.

secondary_source_types: user-provided earnings-call transcript used for management commentary
rejected_or_quarantined: NTM/FY2027/FY2028 values presented as consensus when they are only model inference.
HLC/3 or typical price mislabeled as VWAP or anchored VWAP.
Unsupported attribution to institutional buying, CTA, gamma, short covering or algorithmic flows.
Arbitrary percentage attribution of valuation premium to narrative or optionality components.
unknowns: Exact IPO-instant basic and economic diluted share count after all option exercise timing.
PIT IPO-date and post-Q2 FY2027/FY2028 sell-side consensus under a canonical source.
True NTM revenue consensus after Q2.
Plaque attach/utilization by activated account and unique CCTA denominator.
Independent competitive win/loss and product-level net ASP data.
Current float, settlement-date short interest, borrow/utilization, options positioning and defensible flow attribution.
PIT historical analog event-study evidence for post-earnings continuation.
Verified historical user trade decision or position sizing.

lessons.principle: P0 research priority must be kept separate from New Ignition lifecycle classification.
For a post-IPO high-growth candidate, run current economic diluted EV and reverse 3x/5x/10x math before confirming New Ignition.
A new product S-curve inside an established core business should be classified separately from first-company ignition.
Procedure, patient, revenue-case, ARR, backlog and revenue metrics are distinct; acceleration in one cannot be substituted for another without an explicit bridge.
False New Ignition does not imply False Opportunity; lifecycle and opportunity setup require separate underwriting.
lessons.scope: Event-driven opportunity discovery; requires historical validation before becoming an execution rule.

lessons.principle: Gross-margin leverage is not operating leverage; require OpEx, operating-margin and eventually FCF/share confirmation.
lessons.scope: High-growth software/medtech and other scale-economy cases.
